args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A label mix-up on the PHL account, flagged from the Coastal team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- Could the saved report title be updated to Pellow Home Living so the old name stops showing up?

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti
